summary: JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, enabling remote code execution.
remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.17.1+. Set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true as a stop-gap and remove the JndiLookup class.

summary: The TLS heartbeat extension allows remote attackers to read memory, exposing private keys and secrets.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g+, reissue certificates and rotate secrets.

summary: Jakarta Multipart parser mishandling of Content-Type allows remote code execution via crafted headers.
Side-channel that may allow recovery of an ECDSA private key under specific conditions.
Deserialization of untrusted data via SnakeYAML Constructor can lead to remote code execution.
remediation: Upgrade SnakeYAML to 2.0+ and use SafeConstructor.

summary: Processing of maliciously crafted ASN.1 OBJECT IDENTIFIERs can cause severe performance degradation (DoS).
A flaw in password comparison allows authentication bypass when memcmp returns non-standard values, enabling repeated login attempts to succeed.
remediation: Patch to fixed MySQL/MariaDB build, restrict network access to the DB port, enforce strong auth.

summary: Elevation of privilege flaw in Netlogon (MS-NRPC) allows attackers to impersonate domain controllers.
remediation: Apply Microsoft August 2020 patches and enforce secure RPC.
